metadata.name: Marine Salp Elemental Composition and Biomass Dataset (2004-2021)
metadata.description: A specialized marine biological dataset containing 107 samples of salps, predominantly Salpa aspera, collected across the Pacific Ocean and Southern Ocean. The dataset includes comprehensive biological attributes (size, life stage, tissue type), sampling metadata (expedition, vessel, gear, depth), and detailed elemental composition measurements (carbon, nitrogen, hydrogen ratios, dry mass, ash-free dry mass). Data was collected during multiple expeditions between 2004 and 2021, with a focus on understanding the biogeochemical properties of gelatinous zooplankton.
metadata.spatial: Point locations with variable sampling depth (surface to 3200m), covering a broad geographic range from the Southern Ocean to the North Pacific
metadata.temporal: Irregular sampling events with minute-level timestamp precision; data collected during specific expeditions between 2004 and 2021
